A1.observation: Commercial chip-design entity with outsourced production; report conventions and responsibility are a narrow semiconductor-chain operating issue. No assumption every design office or general electronics factory is an eligible Vietnam ERP buyer.

A2.observation: Operations/SCM influences business-system evaluation at an eligible entity. Actual local buying authority and group-system constraints unknown; process or existing-system improvements remain alternatives. Published China customer not treated as an approved Vietnam target account.

A3.observation: FDI zh-Hans operational business audience. Mainland terms报告/工序/标识/咨询与实施 are directly authored, not Vietnamese literal syntax. Fabless(无晶圆厂芯片设计模式) in explanation caption; ERP(企业资源计划) before first acronym in each ad; MES(制造执行系统) explained in A5 source. No OSAT/WIP used. Language does not establish FDI ownership.

A4.observation: Same implicit business value as v5: common basis for next decision and accountable updates. Report stage -> product/lot convention -> recorded-time/source -> update owner -> shared discussion. No numeric ROI, cost/yield saving, payback, forecast or automatic synchronization promise.

A5.observation: N/A: FDI lane; no domestic supplier-entry, audit success, qualification or orders promise.

A6.observation: Explicit product/lot identifiers, production periods/test classifications, stage/time/report source and confirming update owner. Questions and agreed conventions, not unverified ERP execution functions. Taiwan ERP and MES context stays separate. Illustrative neutral chip/carrier/report props, no owned fab, technical values or customer facility.

A7.observation: Cold decision cue -> report clarification -> convention -> stage/time/source -> responsibility -> decision basis -> Vietnam local consultation -> supplier role -> China identity -> qualitative outsourcing challenge -> same China source reader. Vietnam service and China implementation are separately attributed; no claim Bright received service from Vietnam team or proves exact F1 mechanism.
